rows.Do a report every 8pm and 11pm: For 8pm Report
1. Go to Reports
2. Under reports, go to "Product Totals By Customer"
3. Filter the date for tomorrow's delivery (example: today is 14.10 - the delivery date should be 15.10)
4. Tick the Supplies and To Pick
5. The format should be CSV
6. Once File was downloaded, Filter the products and look for Prepped under Product Group
7. proceed to Prep it Fresh order.
8. Go to Buy Mode in Frontend, select Prep it Fresh
9. Buy all the products under Prep it fresh
10. in ordering for prep it, total the amount of qty and put the Breakdown and customer notes
14. Submit the order once done and tadah!
For 11pm Report
1. Go to Reports
2. Under reports, go to "Product Totals By Customer"
3. Filter the date for tomorrow's delivery (example: today is 14.10 - the delivery date should be 15.10)
4. Tick the Supplies and To Pick
5. The format should be CSV
6. Once File was downloaded, Filter the products and look for Prepped under Product Group
7. Order all the Prepped products in Prep it Fresh
PS: make sure not to order the same products that you ordered earlier from some customers. Order the new Prepped products ordered
